summary: fix(payments): catch a failed load in the PaymentConfigManager constructor
description:
Because:

* The PaymentConfigManager constructor started load() with no catch, so
  a failed Firestore read became an unhandled rejection.

This commit:

* Logs a failed constructor load through the injected logger
* Keeps hasLoaded false so maybeLoad() loads again on the next call
* Adds a regression spec for the logged error and the retry

Closes FXA-14087
